Scripture repeatedly calls us to move forward in faith and not return to the things God has delivered us from. Jesus said, “No one who puts a hand to the plow and looks back is fit for service in the kingdom of God.” God also tells us to remember Lot’s wife, who looked back at Sodom because her heart was still attached to what God was calling her to leave behind.

When God brings you out of a season, a relationship, a sinful habit, or an old way of life, don’t keep longing for what He rescued you from. The enemy wants you focused on your past, but God is calling you toward your future. My prayer is that whenever you’re tempted to look back, the Holy Spirit reminds you that God’s plans ahead of you are far greater than anything you’ve left behind. Keep your eyes on Christ, trust His direction, and continue moving forward in faith.

“Brothers and sisters, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead, I press on toward the goal to win the prize for which God has called me heavenward in Christ Jesus.” Philippians‬ ‭3‬:‭13‬-‭14‬ ‭

So many of us are carrying weight we were never meant to hold. We stress about the future, overthink every detail, and try to control outcomes that are already in God’s hands.

The truth is, peace begins the moment we surrender.🙌🏽🙌🏽🙌🏽

When you trust God fully, you stop chasing what isn’t meant for you and start walking in the direction He has already prepared.

Let go - Trust more - Pray harder 🙏🏽

And remember that God is working behind the scenes even when you can’t see it.

What is meant for you will never miss you.

Sometimes you don’t need answers. Sometimes you don’t need a miracle, a solution, or a sign. Sometimes you just need to stop for a moment, look up to Heaven, and say, “God, I need a hug.”

Life can be exhausting. There are days when your heart feels heavy, your mind won’t slow down, and you’re carrying burdens you don’t even know how to put into words. In those moments, remember that you have a Father who sees everything you’re going through. He sees the tears you hide, the prayers you whisper, and the pain you don’t tell anyone about.

God is not distant from your struggles. He is near to you in the middle of them. His presence can bring comfort where there is hurt, peace where there is anxiety, and strength where there is weakness. When you feel like no one understands, He does. When you feel alone, He is right there beside you.

So if that’s where you are today, don’t be afraid to tell Him exactly how you feel. Ask God for a hug. Ask Him to wrap you in His peace, remind you of His love, and help you keep going. You may not feel everything change overnight, but you’ll discover that His presence is enough to carry you through what you cannot carry alone.
I pray you win those battles you talk to God about.

Yes, accountability matters.

But carrying guilt forever isn’t the same thing as growth.

The cross wasn’t built for perfect people.
It was built for broken people willing to surrender.

You don’t have to earn grace.
You just have to receive it.

If you’re breathing, God is not done writing your story.

God, I’m tired.
Tired mentally, emotionally, and spiritually.
Some days feel heavier than I know how to explain, and I’ve been carrying things that are hard to put into words.

But even in my exhaustion, I choose to trust You.
I trust that You see what I’m going through.
I trust that You are still working, even when I can’t see it.
And I trust that You will give me the strength I need for tomorrow.

Help me rest in Your presence tonight.
Renew my heart, calm my mind, and remind me that I don’t have to carry everything alone.

When I feel weak, be my strength.
When I feel overwhelmed, be my peace.

I may be tired, God…
but I still trust You.

In Jesus’ name, Amen.
